title: Abbas(as) Aajao
body:
Zainab hai khadi bey aas aye Abbas aajao
Hai koi nahi merey paas aye Abbas aajao
1) Zaailim ke tamaachey khaakey sakina' roti hai dekho
Seeney par soney waali reyt pey soti hai dekho
Bujhgayi hai uski pyaas aye Abbas aajao
2) Chaadar cheenengey khaimo'n mey aa aakey sitamgar jab
Sarr uryaa'n hokar baazaaro'n mey jaayegi zainab
Maareygi ye ehsaas aye Abbas aajao
3) Jaatey hii terey khatl huwey akbar bhi asgar bhi
Aur chalgaya gardan e shaah e hudaa par zulm ka Khanjar bhi
Hai ahley haram mey yaas aye Abbas aajao
4) Laakar tu udaadey koii chaadar aye merey bhayya
Jaana hai galii koocha o darr darr aye merey bhayya
Beyparda hai mera raas aye Abbas aajao
5) Hai pusht taley mere haath bandhey khologey nahi bhayya
Mehmil na amaarii hai sarr par kyu kartey nahi saaya
Aye hyder ke almaas aye Abbas aajao
6) Nazro'n se bachaaney mujhko logo'n ki bhayya sarwar
Quran ka soora e kahf sunaatey hai Naiza' chadhkar
Tum aakey padho wannaas aye Abbas aajao
7) Shaano' ke katney par bhi mujhko ghum naa tha koi
Par jaa'n chorhi mashkeeza' chidtey hi my ney bibi
Mujhko na kaho ilyaas aye Abbas aajao
8) Jitney bhi museebat raah e Shaam mey zainab ney jhelaa
Pur dard masaayab *"Gaazi"* raqam karsakta nahi maula
Rotey hai qalam qirtaas aye Abbas aajao
